title: Convert the recorded time to a unified UTC date
goal: uses Date and toISOString to handle time with time zone.
summary: Service logs are from multiple time zones. Archive directories are uniformly created using UTC's YYYY-MM-DD.
tasks: completes archiveDay(timestamp), input as a valid ISO datetime with time zone.
returns the corresponding UTC date string in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

example.note: Z represents UTC, and the conversion sometimes crosses midnight and changes the date.

hint: First new Date(timestamp), convert it into an ISO string, and then intercept the first ten characters.
